howToAttend.metaDescription: Join a PizzaDAO crew call in Discord, what to expect, and your next mission.
howToAttend.dek: Crew calls are open to every member. Here is how to join one.

find.title: Pick a call
find.body: Every crew meets weekly. Find your crew's time in the schedule below, or on the Crews page, and put it in your calendar.

discord.title: Open PizzaDAO Discord
discord.body: Calls happen in the PizzaDAO Discord server. Make sure you have joined and verified.

voice.title: Join the voice channel
voice.body: A few minutes before start time, open the crew's voice channel (look under Voice Channels) and click it to join. You can listen quietly or speak up.

stay.title: Say hi and stay to the end
stay.body: Introduce yourself in the call chat. Attendance is taken from who is in the channel, and that is how you earn your POAP.

howToAttend.recordedBody: Calls are recorded and transcribed so members who miss them can catch up. By joining the voice channel you agree to this.
howToAttend.sliceBody: After you attend, open Call Slices and claim the NFT for that call. We mint it to your wallet and cover the gas.
howToAttend.nextAnon: Log in to see the mission you should do next.
howToAttend.nextNone: You have finished every mission available to you. Nice work.
